summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would prohibit Commonwealth financial and other support for building or refurbishing coal-fired power stations and for purchasing them or transferring their ownership.

The prohibition would cover Commonwealth entities, companies and other defined authorities, including companies controlled by the Commonwealth or specified public bodies, from the day after Royal Assent.
Exceptions would allow support for workers affected by retirement and purchases or ownership transfers intended to help manage a coal-fired power station's closure.
changes: The prohibition would override other Commonwealth laws unless they expressly provide otherwise.
The restriction would not operate where it would acquire property without constitutionally required just terms.
The Crown would be bound in all its capacities.
summary.affected: Commonwealth agencies, publicly controlled companies, coal-fired power station owners and workers affected by retirement would be affected.
